summary: The preacher explains a progressive hierarchy of divine calling—called, justified, sanctified, and glorified—emphasizing that only those who cooperate with the Holy Spirit achieve sanctification and inherit a special promise, urging listeners to identify where they stand.

interpretation.summary: The preacher explains a progressive hierarchy of divine calling—called, justified, sanctified, and glorified—emphasizing that only those who cooperate with the Holy Spirit achieve sanctification and inherit a special promise, urging listeners to identify where they stand.
key_points: Point 1: Theological insight into a four-tier system of calling, urging believers to move beyond justification toward sanctification and glorification.
Point 2: Practical application of living by faith, cooperating with the Spirit, and resisting fleshly desires to align with the sanctified life.
Point 3: Spiritual challenge to recognize one’s current status and to actively pursue the sanctified inheritance through persistent obedience and spiritual work.
interpretation.devotional_takeaway: Commit to living in cooperation with the Holy Spirit today, knowing you are called to grow from justification into sanctification and ultimately the glorious inheritance God promises.
